Method.name: PurgeQueues
Method.Implementation:
Set tStatus = $$$OK Try {
Set tStatus = ..GetEnvironment(.tEnvironment,.tInstanceType,.tInstanceName) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus) Quit:(tEnvironment = "PROD")
Set tStatus = ..Log(.tLogFile,..%ClassName(1),"PurgeQueues","Begin purging queues in " _ $NAMESPACE) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
// SQLPROC Ens.Queue_EnumerateItem to read all items in a queue Set tCall = "Call Ens.Queue_Enumerate()" Set tSQLStatement = ##class(%SQL.Statement).%New() Set tStatus = tSQLStatement.%Prepare(tCall) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus) Set tResultSet = tSQLStatement.%Execute()
While (tResultSet.%Next(.tStatus)) { $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tQueueName = tResultSet.%Get("Name")
;Ignore the queuenames with size zero Set tQueueCount = tResultSet.%Get("Count") CONTINUE:tQueueCount=0
Set tCreated = tResultSet.%Get("Created") ;Ignore the queues if its created within pDaysToKeep Set tQueueDiff = $System.SQL.DATEDIFF("d",tCreated,$ZDT($H,3)) CONTINUE:(tQueueDiff <= pDaysToKeep)
;Ignore the Ens queues CONTINUE:($P(tQueueName,$C(46)) = "Ens")||($P(tQueueName,$C(46))="EnsLib")
Set tStatus = ##class(IHC.EAI.Queue.Util).PurgeQueue(tQueueName,pDaysToKeep,pDoAbort,tLogFile) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus) } $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tStatus = ..Log(.tLogFile,..%ClassName(1),"PurgeQueues","Finished purging queues in " _ $NAMESPACE) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
} Catch eException { Set tStatus = eException.AsStatus() } Quit tStatus
